newsitem.title: USA: Cityscape can't explain stock activity.
newsitem.headline: Cityscape can't explain stock activity.

text.p: Cityscape Financial Corp said Wednesday that it knows of no reason for the unusual trading activity in its stock.
Shares of the consumer finance company, one of the 25 most actively traded Nasdaq stocks Wednesday afternoon, traded at 10-5/16, down 1-11/16.

The company noted that its City Mortgage Corp subsidiary said on August 12 that it had undertaken a voluntary review of its United Kingdom loan portfolio to demonstrate that its UK loan practices were proper and prudent, but that potential costs arising from this review have already been included in its reserves.
